text:
ivy-design: dropped a micro-prototype (no full figma) -> https://figma.com/file/q/compact-rail-breadcrumbs. Proposal pivot: use grouped rail but show a single-line breadcrumb with smart truncation and an explicit "jump" anchor for deep links. want quick sanity check on deeplink semantics + copy.
tom-ux: neat. UX Q: when somebody lands on a deep link (e.g. /w/:ws/assets/:id#versions) do we prefer hash anchors (#versions) or query params (?panel=versions) for client routing? hash is quick for scroll, query is explicit for state.
alex-fe: leaning query param; easier to test and reproduce on server renders. we can still map #anchors for intra-page scroll but keep canonical route: /workspaces/:ws/assets/:id?panel=versions. client boot: expand parent group, scroll to item, focus panel heading. avoid entrance animation on direct load.
dina-pm: copy note: we recently swapped to calling them "Assets" in marketing. let's standardize in console too. breadcrumb should show: "Acme Corp › Assets › MyAsset" — not raw ids. for long breadcrumbs, truncate middle with ellipsis: "Acme Corp › … › MyAsset" and tooltip full path on hover.
ray-a11y: a11y concerns: 1) ensure breadcrumb truncation exposes full accessible name via aria-label (full path). 2) if we open a group programmatically announce: aria-live polite "Assets expanded, 8 items". 3) when deep-link focuses panel heading use tabindex=-1 + focus() so AT reads it. 4) if using hash anchors, ensure we call focus after scroll; some AT won't follow scroll-only changes.
ivy-design: agreed re: aria-label on truncated breadcrumb. also thinking an affordance: small "Open" button in breadcrumb next to workspace name to let folks jump to workspace root. thoughts?
tom-ux: small open button is fine but make sure it's keyboard reachable and in the tab order after the breadcrumb. title attr should be explicit: "Open workspace: Acme Corp".
alex-fe: routing contract sketch we can add to API docs:
/workspaces/:ws/assets/:assetId
/workspaces/:ws/assets/:assetId?panel=versions
/workspaces/:ws/deploy/:envId
We will treat ?panel as canonical. on internal nav we pushState({scrollY, openGroup:'assets', panel:'versions'}). on popstate restore expand + scroll.
dina-pm: permalink ask: can we show a tiny link icon in the breadcrumb (next to MyAsset) that copies canonical URL (with query param) not hash? label should be "Copy link to asset".
ray-a11y: permalink must be a button with aria-label. copy action should announce via aria-live "Link copied to clipboard" so screen reader users know. also ensure the icon has 24px hit target and visible focus ring.
route-lint-bot: route-lint: flagged 1 flaky test -> history-restore.tests failing on /workspaces/:ws/assets flow. see CI #4678.
ivy-design: action items: 1) alex to draft router docs + pushState impl PR. 2) ray to write a11y acceptance text (breadcrumb aria-label, announce strings, focus rules). 3) design to add truncated breadcrumb variant + tooltip. 4) PM to confirm copy standardization to "Assets". 5) eng to triage test flakiness and update tests to check for popstate restore. i'll open GH issues and link. thanks! :tada:
